description: Nearest blocks, biomes, or structures first. `block` takes keys or tags and reads loaded chunks, 32 blocks around by default (`unloadedChunks` counts skipped ones). `biome` reaches unexplored land, 1024 around by default. `structure` takes keys such as `stronghold` or a prefix such as `village`, radius in chunks: keep it modest, it blocks the server thread. Without x and z, it searches around the player, or the spawn for biomes and structures. Needs players:private, or anonymous access the server allows.

world.description: The player's world, or `world`, when left out

name: locate
title: Find blocks, biomes, or structures
